project.name: Synthetic — Northstar Components O2C
project.problemStatement: Northstar Components is a fictional manufacturer with two plants. Sales orders arrive by email and are re-keyed into spreadsheets. Planners cannot see stock across plants, so promised delivery dates change after confirmation. Finance manually reconciles dispatch records with invoices. We want a shared order-to-cash process, reliable inventory visibility, and traceable order, delivery and billing handoffs.

project.name: Synthetic — Cedar Retail Procurement
project.problemStatement: Cedar Retail Group is a fictional retailer operating twelve stores. Buyers raise purchase requests in separate systems and suppliers receive inconsistent purchase orders. Stores record goods receipts late, while finance processes invoices without a consistent three-way match. We want standard purchasing approvals, accurate goods receipts and visibility of blocked invoices across stores and the central warehouse.

project.name: Synthetic — Meridian Distribution
project.problemStatement: Meridian Distribution is a fictional wholesaler serving European and Asian customers. Its SAP sales system and external warehouse software exchange nightly files. Returns are tracked in email, credit notes are delayed and customer-service teams cannot explain stock differences. We want traceable returns, timely stock updates and consistent financial reconciliation. Regional labels such as Île-de-France and 東京 must remain readable.
